title: HTTP Header Analysis — Input
description: Data that must be provided to the AI agent (or to the control) before running the header analysis.

formattedHeaders.description: A text block containing: target domain/URL context (optional), then 'Current Headers:' followed by lines of the form 'Header-Name: value'. This is the only required input for the LLM prompt.

originalUrl.description: Original API endpoint or page URL (for context and report display).

targetDomain.description: Extracted domain from originalUrl (for context and report display).

originalHeaders.description: Raw response headers keyed by name. Used for fallback when AI parsing fails.
